overview.description: The Neuberger Quality Select ETF (NQLT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is a high conviction large- and mid-cap stock strategy that seeks to provide lower risk over a full market cycle.  Stocks are selected based on fundamental research-driven strategy, focusing on US stocks but may include stocks globally. NQLT was launched on Jul 10, 2026 and is issued by Neuberger Berman.
